response.query: MileagePlus secured notes redemption repayment maturity

bullets.text: United redeemed in full the $1.52 billion aggregate principal amount of its MileagePlus 6.5% senior secured notes on July 7, 2025.
Following this redemption and the voluntary prepayment of the associated $1.80 billion secured term loan in July 2024, all indebtedness secured by the MileagePlus assets has been fully repaid.
